description: This PHP source file defines a command class `GenerateOpenApiDocCommand` for a console application using Symfony's Console component. The class configures a command to generate OpenAPI documentation, scan specific plugin directories, handle errors, and output JSON files and HTML for Swagger UI.

classes.name: GenerateOpenApiDocCommand
classes.description: Defines a Symfony Console command to generate an OpenAPI documentation JSON file from code annotations and resources, with options for error handling and output formatting.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command options, including a 'throw' switch for converting warnings into errors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main logic for running the command: runs a code standard fixer, gathers API paths, scans for OpenAPI specs, writes JSON and HTML files, and handles errors based on options.
